page_title: VIL 1-2 PAL | Villarreal v Las Palmas 08/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+13' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+11' Jonathan Viera (Las Palmas) tries a pot shot from the edge of the box, but it goes narrowly wide of the left post.
90+10' Is that a yellow card in the referee's hand? It is! Etienne Capoue (Villarreal) gets booked.
90+10' Villarreal can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
90+7' Jose Luis Morales (Villarreal) wastes a big chance! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box and it goes narrowly over the crossbar.
90+6' Ilias Akhomach (Villarreal) receives a yellow card.
90+5' Sory Kaba (Las Palmas) is yellow-carded for breaking the rules of the game.
90+4' Sergi Cardona (Las Palmas) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
90+4' The resulting set piece from Villarreal is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

90+2' 1 - 2 What a beautiful moment! Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) got to the ball and unleashed a strong shot from distance. It turned out to be a good decision as his effort found its way into the top of the net. Alvaro Valles just shakes his head in disbelief. The score changes to 1:2.
90' We will have 11 min. of added time.
90' Alberto Moreno (Villarreal) commits a rough foul. Alejandro Ruiz stops the game and makes a call.
88' Substitution. Cristian Herrera (Las Palmas) on for Munir El Haddadi.
86' The game is interrupted as Sory Kaba (Las Palmas) is flagged offside.
83' Jose Luis Morales (Villarreal) has a goal ruled out for offside!
82' Alexander Sorloth (Villarreal) is adjudged offside.
77' The ref blows his whistle and we are going to have a so-called cooling break due to the high temperature.
77' Las Palmas fail to score from a corner as Filip Jorgensen (Villarreal) leaps to collect the ball.
76' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Enzo Loiodice walks off the pitch to be replaced by Jonathan Viera (Las Palmas).
76' Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta decides to make a substitution. Javier Munoz will be replaced by Maximo Perrone (Las Palmas).
75' Here comes a substitution. Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) is brought on as a substitute for Manu Trigueros.
73' Villarreal take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
72' Kirian (Las Palmas) goes into the referee's book. Yellow card.
70' Alexander Sorloth (Villarreal) receives a fine cross inside the box and attempts to score a goal, but his strike flies just a few inches over the bar.
69' The referee signals a corner kick to Villarreal.
68' Marvin (Las Palmas) goes in the referee's notebook after being shown a yellow card.
68' Dani Parejo (Villarreal) is cautioned and receives a yellow card.
67' A cross into the box from Alberto Moreno (Villarreal) is cleared.
66' Here is a change. Raul Albiol is going off and Pacheta gives the last tactical orders to Ilias Akhomach (Villarreal).
60' Raul Albiol (Villarreal) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
60' Munir El Haddadi (Las Palmas) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
58' Substitution. Alfonso Pedraza will be replaced by Alberto Moreno (Villarreal).
58' Pacheta prepares a substitution. Ben Brereton Diaz is replaced by Kiko (Villarreal).
58' Substitution. Pejino walks off the pitch and Marvin (Las Palmas) comes on as a substitute.
58' Substitution. Sory Kaba (Las Palmas) has come on for Sergi Cardona.
57' The attendance is 16249.
56' Jose Luis Morales (Villarreal) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom right corner, but Alvaro Valles makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round!

55' Enzo Loiodice (Las Palmas) beats the defender inside the box and lashes a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Filip Jorgensen makes a brilliant reflex save to deny him. Goalkeeping at its best!
51' 0 - 2 GOAL! Marc Cardona (Las Palmas) takes a real chance, but his low driven penalty into the middle of the net fools Filip Jorgensen in goal.
50' Marc Cardona (Las Palmas) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
50' The Las Palmas players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!

49' Play continues despite the shouts by some Las Palmas players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Alejandro Ruiz interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
48' That looked a certain handball by Aissa Mandi (Villarreal) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!
46' Pacheta has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Jose Luis Morales (Villarreal) comes on the pitch for Yeremy Pino.
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45+2' 0 - 1 Saul Coco (Las Palmas) scores a great goal from the resulting free kick from mid-range. He sends the ball directly inside the right post.
45+1' What was Yeremy Pino (Villarreal) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
45' Manu Trigueros (Villarreal) controls a cross inside the six-yard box, but unbelievably sends his shot over the bar.
45' Marc Cardona (Las Palmas) is flagged for offside.
44' The referee blows his whistle as Aissa Mandi (Villarreal) was too aggressive in his challenge.
42' Etienne Capoue (Villarreal) unleashes a decent shot towards the roof of the net, but Alvaro Valles thwarts him with a nice save.
41' Pejino (Las Palmas) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
40' Yeremy Pino (Villarreal) trips an opposition player and Alejandro Ruiz signals a foul.
38' Yeremy Pino (Villarreal) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
36' Dangerous play by Marc Cardona (Las Palmas). Alejandro Ruiz blows his whistle for a foul.
35' Alejandro Ruiz blows for a foul after Juan Foyth (Villarreal) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
35' Yeremy Pino (Villarreal) picks up a pass inside the box and finds some space for a shot before unleashing a low drive goalwards, but one of the defending players blocks his effort.
30' A cooling break is underway.
30' Juan Foyth (Villarreal) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Alejandro Ruiz saw the whole situation.
26' A dangerous towering header by Alexander Sorloth (Villarreal) from around the penalty spot goes just wide of the left post. This corner kick didn't change the score.
26' Dani Parejo (Villarreal) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
23' Ben Brereton Diaz (Villarreal) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
22' Yeremy Pino (Villarreal) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
21' The goalkeeper punched the ball away after Dani Parejo (Villarreal) took the corner.
21' The game is interrupted now, Alfonso Pedraza (Villarreal) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
19' Yeremy Pino (Villarreal) makes a strong challenge and Alejandro Ruiz blows for a foul.
18' Javier Munoz (Las Palmas) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
11' Dani Parejo (Villarreal) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
9' Raul Albiol (Villarreal) brings an opponent down and Alejandro Ruiz interrupts the game.
7' Yeremy Pino (Villarreal) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
6' The linesman raises his flag. Munir El Haddadi (Las Palmas) is adjudged offside.
4' Yeremy Pino (Villarreal) meets an accurate cross inside the six-yard box and attempts a bullet header, but the goalkeeper denies him and makes the save.
1' The first half has started.
